sup:70620.text:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are delighted to assist Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH and remain eager to serve all your requirements from our extensive product range.

We are pleased to submit our offer at a price of €4.96 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, and a contract term of 12 months. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

To give you complete visibility into our underlying costs, please note that LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 10 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C2815 rose 0.8 % in twelve months and is 65 % of our cost. 

As your trusted partner, we pride ourselves on exceptional distributor service and look forward to continuing our successful business relationship.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

move.subject: Re: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

thank you for your offer regarding renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement.
The recorded demand forecast for part:360020 changed by +4.2% (fc:360020@2026-09).
Your recorded on-time delivery rate is 85 % (sc:70620@2026Q3).
The referenced orders for part:360020 each record a price of EUR 4.39 per price unit (po:4500014467-10, po:4500014389-10, po:4500014329-10, po:4500014280-20, po:4500014280-10, po:4500014171-10, po:4500014120-10, po:4500013994-10).
We are happy to pay faster if that helps your cash flow, in exchange for a better price.
Each of the attached packages works for us; please choose the one that suits you best.
Could you send us a cost breakdown for this part?
We value our cooperation and would like an agreement that covers our full need.

Best regards
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH, Purchasing

move.text:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the delivery record data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. That does not change our position. Please understand that as a matter of company policy, we do not share internal cost breakdowns. Material accounts for about 65 % of our cost; more detail we do not share. Our price follows our main cost drivers: PPI-C2815, LCI-C.

We appreciate your willingness to improve payment terms to 14 days, which allows us to offer a revised price of EUR 4.95 per unit.

Our offer is a price of €4.94 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months.

Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 14 days net and a contract term of 12 months: €4.95 per unit.

This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

As a distributor, we always strive to provide you with the comprehensive range and top-tier service you rely on to keep your operations running smoothly.

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

Dear customer,

We acknowledge your revised offer and your continued interest in our products. We truly value our ongoing relationship with Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH and appreciate the opportunity to support your requirements from our extensive range.

However, we are unable to offer further price reductions for this package. This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. 

We can maintain our offer of EUR 4.94 per unit for a 24-month contract with 90 days payment terms. To confirm the complete details of our Angebot, we present a price of €4.94 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months. Please note that this offer remains valid for 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH
